Signed actual source/PR/document candidates; process death at every durable publication phase, recovery/replay without duplicate publication; historical results unchanged.
Two approved plans against same predecessor, exactly one success; retained pinned continuation, mutated plan cannot use original approval.
Dry-run byte comparison; candidate migration, repeat identity, exact original byte retention, rollback; unknown schemas quarantined, never admitted.
Independent backup, remove both current evidence copies and deny retrieval, older release unaffected; delete original store then restore old/current; missing Dolt blocks publication.
Real local Git and Dolt remotes; two clean native clients, competing Dolt branch push, historical retrieval, dirty fetch preservation; LOCAL ONLY, not enterprise.

Actual read-only enterprise reachability probe; writes require approved scratch config. Native two-client writes plus explicitly approved endpoint-specific probes, no local substitution.
24 frozen tasks, two repos/projects, source+operational context; matched file/extracted-index/native-Dolt exact pinned paths, cold/warm costs. NOT model quality.
24 frozen prompts to supplied real model runner on matched source context, exact labelled output, identity/config/raw transcripts; absent runner => blocked nonzero.
No posthoc change: warm p95/context <=1.25 baseline, repeated reads <=0.9 baseline; any violation nonzero.

Signed forward selection and roll-forward preserve intervening audit and correction ledger; no retraction resurrection or evidence-age renewal; exact historical replay unchanged; missing target refuses.

Exact and unique historical source references distinguished from ambiguous/unavailable/malformed inputs; identities and authored CRLF/Unicode/citation bytes retained; interrupted candidate migration recovers; independent original-byte restoration; no prose truth or implicit admission.

48 matched externally attested real model invocation receipts require exact frozen input/transcript hashes, unique invocation identity, model/harness/prompt/tool metadata and expected outputs. Missing or duplicated trials reject; importer does not synthesize or independently execute model calls.

external_prerequisites.enterprise: Approved isolated Git + Dolt scratch URLs, approval reference, credentials, branch prefix, documented retention/permission semantics, endpoint-specific denial/interruption/retention probe commands. Actual read-only probe results are in report commands.
external_prerequisites.agents: Actual model runner config, or a complete real-execution receipt bundle from parent task/completion tools. Mechanical retrieval and exported prompts alone do not satisfy model outcome trials.

no_claims: Installed Gripsack provisioning is parent G01/G12 work, not inferred from Compose execution.
Local native remotes do not prove enterprise data-ref transport or policy protections.
Same-version restored readers do not prove an unspecified older reader version works.
Candidate migration quarantines unsupported legacy schemas; it is not automatic conversion or admission of ambiguous historical knowledge.
